title: Graceful Fallback When Native GPU Surface Fails Initialization
taskDescription: When wgpu surface initialization fails on low-end hardware or virtual machines without Direct3D 12 / Metal, Clypra must smoothly transition to the DOM/canvas readback fallback without throwing an unhandled exception or leaving the preview black.
expectedBehavior: Application logs a native-diagnostic fallback event and seamlessly mounts ProgramPreview.tsx with canvas readback. UI displays an informational banner.
architecturalConstraints: Runtime presenter must be verified directly, never inferred from env vars alone
EvaluatedScene currency must be maintained across fallback path
Fallback state must be tracked in preview qualification state
acceptanceCriteria: Simulation of surface init failure automatically mounts canvas fallback
Playback controls and seeking remain functional in fallback mode
Regression test added in preview test suite
